title: On explicit Fourier expansions of theta lifts to ${\rm SO}(3,n+1)$ arising from elliptic newforms of level one
summary: Using degenerate Whittaker functions and explicit computations of Eisenstein series, we obtain explicit formulas for the Fourier expansions of theta lifts to the special orthogonal group $G={\rm SO}(3,n+1)$ over $\mathbb{Q}$, where $n\ge 3$ and $G$ splits at all finite places. The theta lifts in question are Hecke eigen, non-cuspidal, square-integrable automorphic forms of weight $l$ ($l\ge n+2$, even), arising from elliptic newforms for $\SL_2(\Z)$ of weight $l-\frac{n-2}{2}$ when $n$ is even and $2l-n+1$ when $n$ is odd.
